name: SOX ITGC
full_name: Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404 IT general controls: HCG control set
issuing_body: Heights Consulting Group, for internal control over financial reporting under SOX Section 404 and SEC Rule 13a-15
notice: HCG control set for IT general controls supporting internal control over financial reporting. SOX and the SEC rules set the obligation to maintain and assess internal control but do not list IT controls; the controls here follow the four ITGC domains auditors commonly test (access to programs and data, program change, program development, computer operations) and are written by HCG. Management's assessment and the auditor's attestation are performed against the company's chosen control framework (commonly COSO 2013) and PCAOB AS 2201.

17 CFR 240.13a-15, Controls and procedures

sources.title: HCG SOX ITGC control set: controls, guidance and test points

control_flags.type: hcg for an HCG-written readiness control.

scoring.summary: Percentage of applicable ITGCs operating effectively, with partial effectiveness counting as half. SOX defines no score; management concludes whether internal control over financial reporting is effective, and any material weakness means it is not. This percentage is an HCG readiness measure.

rules.summary: An ITGC is effective only when every HCG test point under it is met.
Management must assess the effectiveness of internal control over financial reporting as of each fiscal year end; ITGCs are in scope where they support systems relevant to financial reporting.
rules.quote: the effectiveness, as of the end of each fiscal year, of the issuer's internal control over financial reporting

rules.summary: Management's evaluation must be based on a suitable, recognized control framework, commonly COSO 2013; these ITGCs support that framework's control activities over technology.
rules.quote: must be a suitable, recognized control framework that is established by a body or group that has followed due-process procedures

rules.summary: The external auditor must attest to management's assessment, except for emerging growth companies and issuers that are neither large accelerated nor accelerated filers.
rules.quote: shall attest to, and report on, the assessment made by the management of the issuer

rules.summary: In the readiness score a partially effective ITGC counts as half. This is an HCG convention.

glossary.definition: Internal control over financial reporting: the process that provides reasonable assurance about the reliability of financial reporting.
IT general control: a control over the IT environment (access, change, development, operations) that supports the reliable operation of application controls and the integrity of financial data.
A deficiency, or combination of deficiencies, in ICFR such that there is a reasonable possibility that a material misstatement will not be prevented or detected on a timely basis.
A deficiency in ICFR less severe than a material weakness yet important enough to merit the attention of those overseeing financial reporting.
A service auditor's report on a service organization's controls relevant to user entities' financial reporting.
